ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the image is an enzyme labeled Enzyme, with a triangular groove at the bottom labeled Active site. The Substrate on the right is drawn as a triangle; Inhibitor #1 is also drawn as a triangle, with a shape that matches the active site; Inhibitor #2 has a different shape and does not seem able to directly match that triangular active site. Then reason: The condition in the question stem is that the inhibitor can bind to the active site of the enzyme and prevent the substrate from binding at the same site. In the image, Inhibitor #1 and the substrate/active site show a relationship of competing for the same active site. This conforms to the definition of competitive inhibition: the inhibitor competes with the substrate for the active site of the enzyme. Therefore, this type of inhibition is competitive inhibition, that is, competitive inhibition.

method.method_draft: 读取题干中“抑制剂能够与酶的活性位点结合并阻止底物在该位点上结合”的条件；结合图中活性位点与底物/抑制剂#1形状相匹配、表示争夺同一位点；应用竞争性抑制的定义，得出该抑制类型为 competitive inhibition（竞争性抑制）。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 这是直接利用题干定义并用图中形状关系验证的单一路线：从活性位点被抑制剂占据、底物无法结合这一特征映射到竞争性抑制。
planner_metadata.image_role: 先读图：图中酶的活性位点画成三角形凹槽，底物也是三角形；抑制剂#1同样呈三角形，显示它可能与底物竞争同一个活性位点，而抑制剂#2形状不同，不像是占据该位点的例子。
planner_metadata.text_role: 题干明确给出关键条件：抑制剂结合酶的活性位点，并阻止底物在同一位点结合；若参考选项文本，则对应“竞争性抑制”。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 生物化学规则：竞争性抑制是抑制剂与底物争夺酶的活性位点，阻止底物结合；非竞争性抑制通常结合活性位点以外的部位。
